visualCharacteristics.summary: Carousel of vehicle cards with price and spec grid
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vehicle stock carousel — "1 / N" counter and prev/next arrows above a strip of grey vehicle cards (3-up at >= 1200px with the next card peeking, 2-up at >= 768px, 1-up below); the active card is 40px taller. Each card: bottom-anchored 4:3 photo, violet uppercase status topline, bold model, price lines, 3-column spec grid (value over grey label); the whole card links to the vehicle. An optional closing light-blue tile links to all vehicles. The section head (eyebrow + `<h2>`) and the carousel head (`<h4>` + head link) are default content before the block and are reabsorbed
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: Carousel chrome matches news-cards carousel, but purpose (vehicle stock), image pattern (photo per card vs none) and structure (price lines + 5-item spec grid) differ.
visualCharacteristics.layout: horizontal strip bleeding into the right gutter
visualCharacteristics.interaction: prev/next buttons, swipe; counter derived from state
